review.why: Guides a blameless incident post-mortem: inputs, UTC timeline, fishbone, 5 Whys and typed action items.
review.summary: Collects incident facts from the user, rebuilds a UTC timeline, uses a fishbone diagram to surface causes, runs 5 Whys on the confirmed branches and writes a post-mortem in the Google SRE structure with detect, mitigate and prevent action items. Markdown by default; HTML, DOCX or PDF on request. A template and a worked example are provided.
strengths: Never invents timestamps, metrics or causes: unknowns become open questions
Fishbone before 5 Whys, with confirmed, suspected and ruled-out labels
Action items are typed and owned by individuals
cautions: DOCX output relies on another skill of the same repository
The template and example files are described, not read in this review
